thread:
szhao: Quick smoke report for v3.2q int4 bring-up on cohort-A (5k queries). posting top-line, will follow up with logs.
prakash: cool — TL;DR?
szhao: p50=45ms, p95=180ms. cost ~=0.42x fp16 baseline. concordance global delta = -0.6% absolute. long-doc slice delta = -1.8% (n=1.2k). short-chat slice +0.1%.
maya: ugh long-doc hit. do we have per-slice sample counts and CI?
szhao: sample counts: long-doc 1200, short-chat 2.4k, codegen 500. bootstrap CI for long-doc delta: [-2.4%, -1.2%] — pretty robust.
prakash: is that beyond our auto-fallback threshold?
maya: quick reminder — policy says auto-fallback if any critical slice delta <= -1.5% OR global delta <= -0.8% with min_samples 1k.
eng-bot: Policy lookup: canary.policy.v2 -> slice_threshold=-0.015, global_threshold=-0.008, min_samples=1000, require_pvalue<0.05.
szhao: so we crossed slice_threshold. p-value for long-doc delta = 0.01.
prakash: then we should trigger fallback for this canary. but before that: any skew in prompts? maybe longer truncation/kv-warmup issue.
maya: checked prompt lengths — cohort median seqlen up 12% vs baseline. KV warmup hit rate low on canary hosts (warmup=0.63 vs baseline 0.92).
szhao: repro local with longer context shows similar drop. suspect int4 KV merge mismatch causing long-doc attention drift.
prakash: next steps: 1) pause promotion 2) enable traffic drain/rollback 3) run focused eval on top 5 failing examples 4) open postmortem if root cause confirmed.
maya: agree. also capture a representative mini-sample to feed to model-surgeon.
szhao: initiating rollback now: /rollout rollback --model v3.2q --reason "long-doc delta -1.8% > slice_threshold"
eng-bot: Rollout command acknowledged. Started drain and switched route tag->v3.1. Confirmed: routing 100% -> v3.1 within 2m.
prakash: good. can we attach the quick-run eval artifact id?
szhao: artifact: s3://redwood-evals/1758202468/v3.2q-smoke-5k.jsonl
maya: capture perf traces too (p95 heatmap) — upload to the ticket.
szhao: done. uploaded traces and sample examples. link: https://redwood.internal/evals/1758202468
prakash: doc note — revisit int4 KV merge and quant kernel selection. run local microbench for seqlen distributions matching long-docs (seqlen ~> 250).
maya: also schedule an abbreviated A/B with stratified long-doc oversample (n=3k) once candidate fix is ready.
szhao: will coordinate. timeline: triage today, investigate kernel/merge tonight, small patch + recluster tomorrow, then shadow run.
eng-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0479 (auto-fallback triggered by canary policy). Assigned: szhao, prakash. SLA: 72h.
prakash: thanks. quick checklist: ensure min_samples gating avoids noisy small-slices; confirm thresholds still aligned with user-facing long-doc SLAs.
maya: noted. I’ll add a short runbook blurb to the canary policy with an explicit long-doc checklist.
szhao: thanks — will follow up with post-triage notes in this thread. :thumbsup:
